author: NSA_Chatbot
body:
Any cheap jewel is better than no jewel; a blacksmith can free up the slot when you find something better (this destroys the jewel). 

There are probably better things than the arch-gadget, but it's up to you.  That mail is a great roll!  Mine's maybe half that good.  

If you equip things for PvP, put them in the PvP tab.  (Remember to change your skills too, and scroll down to the settings to change the AI behaviour.)

author: Verdecilloman
body:
adorn your equipment, the dungeon reward give some good jewelry.

On the other hand, for world, don't use the arch-gadget, do you really need to buff yourself to kill a mob?

Better go with some item that give you magic, immunity or orn rewards.

for the head, change it for a lost helmet... or a nothern hood.

For the legs, king's boots to compensate the lack of res.

but, above all, is a nice gear what you have..
